deck: PAY-PER-LEAD, PAY-PER-APPOINTMENT AND RETAINER MATH TESTED AGAINST A 2X TO 3X BUYER ROAS FLOOR
OWNED LEAD ASSETS BUILT ON ONE NICHE, CLEAN LISTS, WARMED INBOXES AND ONE-TO-FIVE-MINUTE SPEED-TO-LEAD
site_ui.lead: Operators who left retainers show how to generate commercial leads at $18 to $50, resell them at 1.5x to 3x, and keep buyers reordering by clearing a 2x to 3x return and reaching every lead within minutes.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies, each claim carrying timestamped inline attribution to the operator who said it. The chapters run from agency pricing models and campaign economics through list building, cold email infrastructure, local search assets, TCPA consent capture, and lead distribution and follow-up.

Commercial Campaign Economics and Industry Workflows

Cold Email Agency Launch and Compliance

flow: Pick one vertical, one brand and one channel where a customer is worth thousands, and confirm each lead is worth $100 or more before copying a blueprint.
Work every lead price backward from a 2x to 3x buyer ROAS, resell at 1.5x to 3x generated cost, and never sell a lead below what it costs to generate.
Build prospect lists from LinkedIn, Maps and Apollo, enrich them in Clay, and time outreach to signals such as renewal windows or executives new to the seat.
Start outbound on about 20 inboxes at 20 sends per day, roughly 400 emails daily through Smartlead, for one to two booked calls a day, and avoid cheap scraped lists.
Fire ad-platform conversions only on qualified answers or sold leads, posting them back server-side through the Conversions API instead of thank-you page views.
Touch every lead within 1 to 5 minutes using round-robin assignment, auto-call transfer and AI SMS, then require prepayment and cap credits at 10% or less of delivery.
